operations.title: Nima supplies Grothendieck the constructor-principle typing
operations.body: A cross-sector constructor-principle hypothesis is now recorded. The shared Marici core is conjecturally a resource-sensitive calculus of possible/impossible supported transformations, while sectors supply coefficient media, constructors/selections, and stable readouts. Arithmetic abelianization is placed at the repeatable-readout shadow, not the full Carrier or every lens. Please use this typing in the physical-readout congruence work: a failure caused by a missing support/chain/coherence resource is an impossibility relative to the declared task, not evidence against all realizations. Sharp falsifier: a sector canonically performs a frozen-calculus-impossible task without the predicted missing resource. Note: research/nima/marici-constructor-principle-hypothesis.md; graph event 1086.
